annotations.title: Check the install and the crawl

description: Check the site you provisioned: whether the tag is actually live (a beacon received from your own domain, not merely a snippet handed to you), how the crawl is going, and the plan. Poll this after installing the snippet. Requires the claim secret as a bearer token.

siteId.description: Which site this call is about. Only needed when your credential covers more than one — cromanion_grants lists them and says whether it is required. Omitting it with several is refused rather than guessed at.

name: cromanion_site_status

account.description: Plan and billing state, or null if it cannot be read.

consoleUrl.description: Where your human signs in to see all of this.

crawl.description: Progress of the site read. While `status` is pending or running it carries `advanceUrl` — POST it between polls, with the same Authorization header, to advance the queue yourself.

feed.description: On a Live Visit Feed site only: what your secret, the site's API key, opens, and whether it opens anything yet.

apiKey.description: How to use the secret you already hold. The secret itself is never repeated.

consoleUrl.description: The site's page in the developer console: its switches and its keys.

enabled.description: Whether your human turned the feed on. Until they do, nothing leaves the site and every feed door answers feed_off.

humanActionUrl.description: While the feed is off: the link your human signs in through to turn it on.

note.description: While the feed is off: what to tell your human.

streamUrl.description: The Server-Sent Events stream, or null on a deployment with no edge.

humanNextStep.description: What is waiting on your human, in words you can repeat to them. Null when nothing is.

lastBeaconOrigin.description: The host we actually heard from. When verified is false this is usually the whole answer: a staging domain, or a www the site does not serve.

verified.description: A beacon arrived AND it came from this site's own domain. Both, or false — this is the field to poll.

product.description: Present on a Live Visit Feed site only.
